run_NPMDemo_predict: run the NPMDemo predict method to fill in masked text spans using the NPM model
run_NPMDemo_generate: run the NPMDemo generate method to autoregressively generate text from a prompt using NPM
run_NPMDemo_bm25_search: run the NPMDemo bm25_search method to retrieve relevant text blocks matching a query
run_NPMDemo_init: run the NPMDemo class to initialize an NPM model with a DataStore and stopword mask
run_main_demo: run the main demo script to predict, generate, and search text using NPM via argparse CLI
